name: setpgid
description: The setpgid() system call sets the process group ID of a specified process. It allows the caller to associate a process with a new process group, ensuring both are in the same session if changing groups.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The process ID to set the PGID for; if zero, the calling process's ID is used.

parameters.name: pgid
parameters.description: The new process group ID; if zero, the process group ID is set to the process ID.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: An attempt was made to change the process group ID of a child process that has already performed an execve(2)
The pgid value is less than zero
An attempt was made to move a process into a different session, change a session leader's PGID, or the target process group does not exist
The specified pid is not the calling process and not a child of the calling process
